name: Basic Electronics Company
verdict: Basic Electronics Co. Ltd (Al-Asasyah) is a limited liability company owned by its founder Mohammad Ahmad Al Arfaj and run by his family. Nothing found.
note: Front-of-shirt sponsor of Al-Fayha 2026-27; the shirt carries the Fisher brand, which Basic Electronics markets in Saudi Arabia (club announcement of 17 August 2026 calls the company '(فيشر)'). Al-Khaleej's 2026-27 front sponsor 'fisher-electronics' appears to be the same advertiser's brand.
